tools.name: score_cv
tools.description: Assess only the supplied CV against atomic job requirements using Jev evidence probabilities. Returns one source score, assessmentKind=source_only, method=jev-probability-v1 and per-requirement met/not_met/unknown probabilities, confidence and actual model version. Every requirement stays in the den

tools.name: tailor_cv
tools.description: Tailor a CV/resume to a specific job posting: rewrites the CV with the posting's ATS keywords (rules and automated checks are designed to prevent added facts; AI can make mistakes), and returns the tailored CV, a match score, role-fit notes, interview prep and a cover letter (null when it could not
